register_guardrail: De-ceremonialized Qitchen: Tekka is $20-30 dine-in/takeout/delivery sushi, not omakase/ticketed fine dining. Use Qitchen precision and high-design menu presentation while preserving order/call/directions conversion.
rationale: Tekka is a modern sushi/Japanese concept where the redesign must communicate precision, freshness, presentation, and visual trust. Google review evidence supports fresh sushi/sashimi, beautiful presentation, chic/modern atmosphere, and attentive service. The owned-site failure is menu credibility, so Qitchen's architectural menu and visual discipline are the best base.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Too cuisine-agnostic; would fix clarity but lose sushi-specific precision and presentation.
Too trendy/cinematic and saturated for Tekka's fresh, precise, modern sushi proof points.
Too warm/generic; would underuse the modern/chic sushi opportunity.

modifiers.palette: deep charcoal / warm white / rice-paper neutral with restrained wasabi/seaweed accent
modifiers.typography: modern editorial sans plus restrained display; avoid full ceremonial austerity
modifiers.cta: Order Online, View Menu, Call to Reserve, Directions
modifiers.menu: category-stack or tabbed real menu with signature rolls, sushi/sashimi, ramen, lunch specials, platters
modifiers.proof: Google 4.8 / 370 reviews with captured packet; themes not fabricated testimonials
modifiers.gallery: food-first and verified room imagery only
modifiers.mobile: sticky action bar for Order / Call / Directions

required_sections: Hero with modern sushi positioning and primary CTAs
Trust strip with Google rating, address, dine-in/takeout/delivery
Visit block with address, phone, hours caveat, directions
